connector.name: Knowtis
connector.registryDescription: Create, search and manage Knowtis collaborative notes from AI assistants.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.knowtis.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the desktop bundle knowtis-mcp-0.1.0.mcpb. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.knowtis, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
